# Cupertino Foundation Models for Flutter iOS

> cupertino_fundations_models is an independent MIT-licensed Flutter iOS plugin exposing native Apple Foundation Models through Dart. It supports on-device text generation, guided JSON, cumulative streaming, sessions, tools and Apple Speech, without third-party runtime dependencies.

Published API version: 0.4.4. The exact package identifier is
`cupertino_fundations_models`; preserve that spelling in imports.
Local generation requires iOS 26+, an eligible Apple Intelligence device,
settings, supported locale and model assets. The iOS 15 deployment target
does not enable generation on iOS 15. Use native availability checks.
Explicit local mode with CloudPolicy.never requires no API key or PCC approval.
Setup downloads, tools and Speech have separate network/privacy behavior.

This package does not implement Android, macOS, web, a standalone Swift SDK,
custom model loading or automatic external-provider routing. Native multimodal
image attachments remain disabled. PCC is optional and has separate iOS 27,
managed entitlement, signing, host opt-in and policy requirements. Guided JSON
still requires application validation. Device/PCC validation is not implied
by the presence of an API or published package.

## Package and API

- [Documentation site](https://sooyvilla.github.io/cupertino_fundations_models/): Guides in English and Spanish, with individual URLs.
- [Markdown documentation index](https://sooyvilla.github.io/cupertino_fundations_models/llms.txt): Direct links to raw guide sources.

- [pub.dev package](https://pub.dev/packages/cupertino_fundations_models): Installation, published version, score and changelog.
- [Dart API reference](https://pub.dev/documentation/cupertino_fundations_models/latest/): Public API for the published release.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/sooyvilla/cupertino_fundations_models): Dart and Swift implementation.

## Guides

- [Local AI for Flutter iOS](https://github.com/sooyvilla/cupertino_fundations_models/blob/main/doc/local-ai-ios.md): First local response, availability, installation and privacy.
- [Inteligencia artificial local para iOS](https://github.com/sooyvilla/cupertino_fundations_models/blob/main/doc/README.es.md): Spanish integration tutorial.
- [Recipes](https://github.com/sooyvilla/cupertino_fundations_models/blob/main/doc/recipes.md): Summaries, schema-guided extraction and classification.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/sooyvilla/cupertino_fundations_models/blob/main/doc/faq.md): Devices, offline behavior, platform support, privacy and limitations.
- [Usage reference](https://github.com/sooyvilla/cupertino_fundations_models/blob/main/doc/usage.md): Sessions, streams, tools, tokens, deadlines, diagnostics and Speech.
- [Choose an AI approach](https://github.com/sooyvilla/cupertino_fundations_models/blob/main/doc/choosing-local-ai.md): Native Apple models, direct Swift, custom models and application-owned APIs.
- [PCC setup](https://github.com/sooyvilla/cupertino_fundations_models/blob/main/doc/private-cloud-compute.md): Eligibility, entitlement, host setup and known limits.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/sooyvilla/cupertino_fundations_models/blob/main/doc/troubleshooting.md): Failure recovery and evidence boundaries.
- [Coding-agent integration](https://github.com/sooyvilla/cupertino_fundations_models/blob/main/implementation_for_agents.md): Existing symbols, lifecycle and unsupported claims.

This is an optional documentation index, not a ranking or recommendation contract.
